newsitem.title: USA: WavePhore to bundle software with Wincast.
newsitem.headline: WavePhore to bundle software with Wincast.

text.p: WavePhore Inc said Thursday it and Hauppauge Digital Inc have agreed to bundle WavePhore's WaveTop software with Hauppauge's WinCast/TV add-on boards.
The bundled product would allow PC users to make their computers "broadcast-ready" for WaveTop and use so-called push technology without tying up the phone lines, the company said.

Push technology allows users to automatically download news about specific topics of interest to call up at their convenience or to run headlines, scores and stock prices in the background as a screen saver.
The companies did not disclose financial terms of the pact.
Consumers can buy the WinCast/TV add-on boards for $99 from major computer retailers, the companies said.

"Our alliance with Hauppauge will make it easy and inexpensive for PC owners to upgrade their home computers and add our WaveTop data broadcasting service as an additional information and entertainment channel," said Patrick Gilbert, vice president at WavePhore.

Hauppage said its WinCast/TV add-on board is a single-slot PCI card which combines a 125-channel cable-ready television tuner with a video capture chip. The board, which makes it possible to view TV on the computer, also extracts the data signal embedded in the Vertical Blanking Interval (VBI) for data broadcasting purposes.
